messages:
matt (sec-eng): Auditor needs mapping of RBAC changes + KMS access during the Mar 2 incident. They want CloudTrail events for role assumption/service principal creation/role attachments, KMS GenerateDataKey/Decrypt/Encrypt events, and PR links for RBAC changes. Also timestamped evidence showing key rotation and who initiated it.

priya (infra): I can export CloudTrail events to S3. What exact time window & principal ARNs?

auditor_lee: Window: 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z -> 2025-03-05T23:59:59Z. Principals: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/sp-abc123/* , arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/sp-def456/* . KMS key ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345

matt (sec-eng): Perfect. Also include CloudWatch logs for the instance that called KMS (lambda-auth-proxy). We'll need PR diffs for the RBAC change (it was a hotfix on 2025-03-02). @anna can you paste PR ids?

anna (sre): PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4523 (hotfix: tighten sp-abc123 policy)
https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4524 (revert accidental wide S3 perms for sp-def456)
Commit hashes: 9f1b7d3, c4a2be8

priya (infra): I'll run exports. Example commands I'm using:

```bash
# CloudTrail lookup by resource name
aws cloudtrail lookup-events \
  --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sp-abc123 \
  --start-time 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-03-05T23:59:59Z

# Filter KMS events in CloudTrail S3 bucket (Athena sample)
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE cloudtrail_kms (...);
SELECT * FROM cloudtrail_kms WHERE eventName IN ('GenerateDataKey','Decrypt','Encrypt') AND eventTime BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2025-03-05';
```

matt (sec-eng): For KMS rotation proof: include KeyRotationEnabled flag and the CloudTrail Record for UpdateKeyDescription or RevokeGrant that shows who called it. Also, if rotation was via AWS console vs automation, include the initiating IAM principal.

sec-bot: Uploaded snapshot to s3://redwood-audit-evidence/3309876543/

auditor_lee: Can you provide the raw CloudTrail event for a sample Decrypt call that ties to sp-abc123? We need fields: eventTime, eventSource, eventName, userIdentity. eventName must be Decrypt or GenerateDataKey.

priya (infra): Here's a redacted sample (IDs masked):

```json
{
  "eventTime": "2025-03-02T18:22:31Z",
  "eventSource": "kms.amazonaws.com",
  "eventName": "Decrypt",
  "awsRegion": "us-west-2",
  "sourceIPAddress": "54.12.34.56",
  "userIdentity": {"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/sp-abc123/session"},
  "requestParameters": {"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"}
}
```

auditor_lee: Good. Need a link to the PR diff for the RBAC change and a short description of why it was made (for control mapping). Also, who approved and when.

anna (sre): PR 4523 description: 'restrict sp-abc123 to kms:Decrypt only for specific key and deny s3:PutObject' Approved by @matt (sec-eng) + @julia (platform) on 2025-03-02T20:10Z.

matt (sec-eng): I'll sign the approval note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4523/approvals (screenshot uploaded to the s3 bucket). Also attached the incident ticket: IN-2025-078 (timeline and mitigation steps).

auditor_lee: Last ask: export of KMS key metadata (rotation enabled flag + key rotation schedule if any) and the KMS key policy used at the time.

priya (infra): Command to get key metadata:

```bash
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id abcd-ef01-2345
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id abcd-ef01-2345 --policy-name default
```

matt (sec-eng): We'll package everything into s3://redwood-audit-evidence/3309876543/ with a manifest.csv. ETA: EOD today.

auditor_lee: Thanks — will review and follow up if anything missing :thumbsup:
